text:
Ethan: heads-up: customer Nimbus wants a Q3 pilot for per-tenant adaptive routing + prefetch. asking for a 3-week timeline. need cross-team owners and a crisp acceptance checklist.

Priya: infra estimate: VPC peering + allowlist ~8 business days, warm-pool orchestration needs 2x infra engineers ~5 days. staging-only changes preferred to avoid prod risk.

Rina: product acceptance proposal: p95 <=200ms on pilot routes, eval regressions <2%, and a documented fallback SLA. also decide whether pilot is whitelisted premium or open beta.

Omar: runtime can add tenant config + prewarm hooks. estimate 4 dev days for API + tests. tradeoffs: warm pool size vs cost. suggest max seq 512 for prewarm.

Lena: security: KMS + audit logs is fastest. HSM is an extra 3-4 weeks. I need a key rotation plan and access list. If Nimbus requires HSM, move to enterprise track.

Sam: release gating: canary 5% for 24h with monitors (p95, errors, cost, quality). rollback if p95 > baseline+10% or quality regression >2.5% or cost >30% over expected. dashboards + alerts must be ready before canary.

Ethan: proposed owners: runtime=Omar, infra=Priya, security=Lena, release=Sam, product lead=Rina. Action items: Omar PR + perf baselines by Thu, Priya infra tickets + staging window by Fri, Lena KMS plan by Fri, Sam mock dashboards by next Tue.

Omar: I'll include a feature-flagged fallback and a sample tenant YAML in the PR:
```
tenant_prefetch:
  enabled: true
  warm_pool: 12
  max_seq: 512
  fallback: r-small-1
```
Will attach perf numbers.

Priya: I'll file infra tickets and mark them high priority. Ethan  can you DM Nimbus IP list?

Ethan: sending IPs now, scheduling 30m triage tomorrow 11am to close gaps. :thumbsup:
